proposal:
SCOPE. No source seen, nothing executed. v3 behaviour is inferred from the brief and the two receipts. Nothing here is a polynomial SAT algorithm, and I know no route from this architecture to one. The watcher handoff has no statements and is unused. My fixture 61 prediction failed (4 predicted, 2 observed): I underestimated node inference.

1. RESIDUAL-WORK INVARIANT. R_i(F,pi) := number of distinct raw residual clause sets F|a over assignments a to the first i order variables that falsify no clause.
Theorem A (classical cut-trace bound, elementary). R_i <= 2^min(f_i,c_i), where f_i = prefix variables sharing a clause with the suffix and c_i = clauses crossing the cut. If states with equal raw residual are merged, layer_i <= R_i under any sound node inference.
Lemma B (lift neutrality). For a pair lift F = G o p with paired variables adjacent, R_2j(F) = R_j(G). Proof: after closing j pairs, F|a is the lift of G|p(a), and lifting is injective on clause sets.
So dedup already quotients by fibres at closed layers. BLQ saves at most the open-block factor and node cost. A skip is neutral for pair lifts, and compression cannot bound residual growth, since every CNF is a quotient. Receipt check (hand count): the peer fixture has R_1..R_5 = 2,2,4,4,8, matching v3 layers 2,2,4,4 and baseline layer 5. v3 then refuted all 8 children by IALH, which took 9.2 of 9.67 s. The quantity to bound is work, sum_i children_i * node cost, not peak.

2. WHAT DP DOES. Size-nonincreasing DP is bounded variable elimination. For one 3-bit automaton chain with a fresh input per step, I eliminated by hand: every step shrank the clause set (24 to 10 per input; 12, 9, 6 to 8, 6, 3 per state bit), so root DP alone computes forward images and refutes it. Heuristic conclusion: growth needs information that cannot be forgotten, which forces large R_i. The open question is which large-R formulas node inference refutes.

3. KERNEL-FREE NONLINEAR CLASS C(c). States s_0..s_2c in {0,1}^3; S = {000,001,010,100}; g = (000 001 010) fixing 100, h = (000 100 001) fixing 010; controls e_1..e_c. Step t applies g or h according to e_((t mod c)+1), constrained only for states in S. s_0 = 000; the end requires two bits of s_2c set. n = 7c+3, 48c+5 clauses of width 5.
Hand-checked facts: (i) UNSAT, since 'at most one bit set' is inductive. (ii) Resolution refutation of width 5 and size O(c): resolve the two control cases, then the three invariant clauses. (iii) Every exact-support block has trivial stabilizer, so there is no BLQ kernel. (iv) S and its complement each have full integer affine hull, so no affine or modular equation expresses the invariant. (v) Each control is reused c steps later; eliminating it creates up to 288 cross resolvents, so DP rejects, and R_i = 2^k after k controls.
Prediction for v3: a state with k controls assigned is refuted by one IALH window iff c-k <= 2 (assigned state bits fix one control by unit propagation, the tuple fixes the other, propagation then runs to the end). So peak = 2^(c-3): 2 at c=4 (the fixture: variable 4 retains 2, variable 8 retains 0, compression skipped), 8 at c=6 (45 variables), 32 at c=8 (59 variables, inside v3 caps). On the fixture, 0 means root inference finds a non-affine invariant; 4 means the window horizon is one control.

4. ONE IMPROVEMENT: WINDOW IMPLICATES. From each UP-filtered window table already computed, export every clause of width <= 2 over the window that no surviving tuple falsifies. Sound because the table contains the projection of all solutions. Add as windows the five-subsets of unions of two clause supports sharing four variables. On C(c) the window {s_t, a_(t+1), b_(t+1)} yields the invariant clause once the previous one is present, so the root refutes in at most 2c rounds: predicted peak 0 for every c, against 2^(c-3). This is a fragment of k-consistency, which captures bounded-width resolution (Atserias-Dalmau, from memory). Its limit is equally known: formulas needing linear width.

5. AUDIT (new items).
(a) v3 dedups after Canon/SCC/DP. Theorem A needs raw-residual merging; if normalization is path-dependent, equal residuals stay distinct. Test: a raw BFS counter; observed layer_i <= R_i on all 736 controls with DP off. A violation is a located defect.
(b) Quotient order is ascending basis rank, not the supplied order. Lemma B transfers bounds only for closing-time order (rank a form by the last original position in its support).
(c) Two blocks with different supports can induce the same quotient clause; a strict partition check then rejects a valid certificate. Sound, but an unexplained skip.
(d) Certificate cost is sum_B 2^c_B * d_B * c_B plus O(r^2 n) bit operations over GF(2), with no coefficient growth: polynomial at fixed block width, exponential in it. IALH elimination is over integers and needs an asserted bit-length bound.
(e) A skip is sound only if root normalization is equivalence-preserving; it needs its own check.

6. ARBITRARY SAT. Extra clauses: (G o p) and E is general SAT when G is empty, so any theorem needs an explicit parameter of E; R_i(F) <= R_i(G o p) * R_i(E) is all I can prove. Universally one needs polynomially many unrefuted states for every CNF. Raw traces cannot supply that (expander CNFs have linear f_i in every order), and bounded-width inference cannot either. The claim rests entirely on node refutation power, for which no theorem exists.
missing_theorem:
T-SEP (inference separation on C(c)). Prove both halves from the v3 source.
(a) Lower bound. For every state reached by assigning k <= c-3 controls in first-use order: (1) every UP-filtered clause-support window keeps a surviving tuple; (2) the integer lattice system assembled from all window hulls is consistent; (3) every DP elimination strictly increases Canon size; (4) no two such states share a normalized form. Then v3 performs at least 2^(c-3) node evaluations at n = 7c+3, i.e. 2^(n/7 - O(1)), on formulas with O(n)-size, width-5 resolution refutations.
(b) Upper bound. With window implicates on five-subsets of unions of two supports sharing four variables, root refutation in O(c) rounds and O(c^2) window evaluations.
I have hand arguments for (1) and (3) on the windows and eliminations I examined, none for (2), and (4) depends on SCC representative choice. If (a) holds, v3 is exponentially weaker than width-5 resolution on an explicit family, which fixes what must be added first; the next obstruction is then width itself. If (2) fails, IALH is stronger than my model and the fixture will show it.
self_attack:
1. Every v3 prediction is inferred. My model: windows are clause supports (consistent with 12 windows and 192 tuples at the root of fixture 61), tuples are filtered by unit propagation only, one pass per call, and only affine or lattice consequences are exported. If windows are richer or consequences are iterated, the fixture peak is 0 and the 2^(c-3) law is false.
2. Peak 2 at 31 variables is not growth. The fixture calibrates the window horizon; the growth claim lives at 45 to 59 variables and is untested.
3. The lattice step is the part I understand least. Neon54 showed global modular contradictions I did not anticipate. A non-affine S blocks the obvious invariant, not every lattice combination.
4. Theorem A is textbook cut-width caching, not new mathematics, and v3 does not merge on raw residuals, so it bounds a modified solver. With DP-eliminated order variables only 3^f_i follows.
5. The DP image computation was done by hand for one transition pair, not the fixture's.
6. Window implicates may already exist in v3 under another name; then section 4 is void. If absent, they add clauses every round and may raise later node cost.
7. C(c) is easy by design. Beating it says nothing about formulas needing large width, where no local closure helps. The class is a diagnostic, not progress toward the goal.
8. Literature attributions are from memory and unverified.
9. The fixture has 197 hand-generated clauses. A transcription error could change satisfiability; the oracle overrides my UNSAT claim.
mechanism_signature: Non-forgettable control bits plus a non-affine inductive invariant: raw cut-trace 2^k, width-5 resolution-easy, BLQ-kernel-free, DP blocked by late reuse; IALH single-window horizon of two controls; repair by width-2 window implicates.
delta_from_prior: Fixture 61 was an abelian pair lift whose depth I overestimated. This round drops lifts, cores and list selection. New: the raw-residual trace invariant with lift neutrality (compression cannot bound residual growth); the hand-elimination observation that size-nonincreasing DP computes forward images, so growth requires unforgettable state; a kernel-free family with a non-affine invariant and an explicit scaling law 2^(c-3); one inference repair with a stated completeness target; T-SEP replaces T-SELECT as the first missing theorem.
